label: D1 reward after reaching S2, following an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of activations; never at GO/D2 or on unrewarded D1). Within rewarded D1s it is selective for reward coming from S2 (prev_state == 2; ~78% of activations) and, strongly, for a reward that follows an unrewarded trial (two trials back reward != 1): adding that condition raises precision from 0.26 to 0.66. Recorded predicate uses only observed history (dev F1 0.61, mass recall 0.74). Most remaining misses are on the window first trial (rel -3) where prev_state is unknown in the window; adding (rel == -3 & upcoming action == a2) brings mass recall to 0.95 at F1 0.58. Upcoming choice a2 alone (with rewarded D1) covers 98% of mass but with precision 0.24. Activation also depends strongly on episode position (rises through trials 40-79, near zero after trial 80), which no observed task variable captures, so precision stays incomplete. Policy at GO is moderately negative (favoring a2, choice in [-4.4, -1.5]) when it fires, not strongly committed. Low-magnitude unit (max ~0.001).
